Chapter 6035: It’S A Good Thing Poye’S Dead

Chapter 6035: It’s A Good Thing Poye’s Dead

“Your Majesty, there are rumors of Splendor Terra once being the home of an immortal, is this true?” Minisun took advantage of this opportunity.

“That’s part of the legend but I haven’t seen any special ruins yet. Moreover, the immortal is no longer around.” Unrivalled nodded.

“Right, Immortal Slaughtered and Heavenslay.” Minisun murmured.

“They became ruins after Heavenslay, most likely.” Unrivalled added.

“From what I heard, four immortals fell during Heavenslay. Your palaces must have originated from them.” Minisun remarked.

“Who knows, maybe they’re still alive, just missing.” Unrivalled shook her head.

“Supreme Heaven’s stance is that Dingtian swept through Three Immortals and killed the four.” Minisun said.

Heavenslay War lasted many eras. Sources said different things regarding the main participants and the outcome. One mentioned a total of six immortals but another account stated they were cultivators dubbed as supreme terrors.

Either way, these six stood at the apex of Three Immortals. None was stronger than them after Immortal Slaughtered War.

After Heavenslay, the six left the stage. Most believed they had been killed but all in all, stories about them stopped being recorded.

Dingtian and his immortal supporter also paid a heavy price for their victory. Dingtian suffered a fatal blow, eventually succumbing to this injury.

The legacies of these great beings were scattered across the world. Splendor Terra was built on one of them, or so people claimed.

They didn’t know where Splendor Monarch found one and the method employed to drag it back here from outer space.

“Supreme Heaven isn’t to be trusted, they have been wanting to take over but Desolate Ancestor and Lord of Life and Death will never let that happen.” Unrivalled said.

“It’s a good thing Poye is dead or nothing will change in this generation.” Minisun said sentimentally.

“Right, I hope Lord of Life and Death’s group is still alive.” Unrivalled said. She was certainly strong but not enough to influence the higher-level cultivators.

“We can only hope.” Minisun sighed.

Splendor Terra was relatively neutral but Enigma certainly sided with Desolate Ancestor against Supreme Heaven.

“A fight?” Li Qiye frowned and glanced at the horizon.

“Boom!” A blast of the imperial nature erupted.

Minisun felt the source of this power and stood up in astonishment: “Six-style!”

She leaped out of the palace without another word and disappeared into the sky.

***

“Boom!” Something resembling a mushroom cloud gathered due to the explosion of a dao fruit.

“Damn! An emperor is self-imploding!” Spectators were horrified after seeing this.

“Six-style!” Emperors and desolate gods in Enigma were woken up.

“Your Majesty!” The strongest cultivators in the dynasty became alarmed.

“Don’t even think about it!” Someone shouted and activated his power.

A golden hand as bright as the sun descended and contained the power, wanting to stop the explosion and crush the dao fruit.

“Yangrune from Immortal Suppression!” Unrivalled stood up and crossed through the dimensions to reach the battlefield.

“How dare you?!” She shouted and thrust her spear, leaving a long energy trail in the air.

Many inhabitants of Sin saw the spear crossing through the sky and were astounded.

“Unrivalled Monarch!” They shouted her title after seeing her monstrous power.

“Rumble!” The world shook violently due to her frightening aura.

Living beings in the nearest ten million miles trembled, ancestors included. They hid and didn’t dare to show themselves.

“Is this a declaration of war?” Many turned pale.

“If the great dynasties start something, many sects will be dragged into the mess too.” An ancestor lamented.

Immortal Suppression, Enigma, and Phantom had virtually full sovereignty over Sin. A war between them could last for generations. Other sects didn’t want to be involved but were powerless as tributaries.

“Yangrune is trying to kill Six-style.” Those closest to the battlefield became emotional.

A spear entered the battlefield and aimed straight for Yangrune.

“Unrivalled Monarch is so strong, who could stop her now?” The incoming desolate gods and emperors were amazed by her attack.

“Only cultivators as strong as Immortal Suppressor and Specter Ancestor.” Someone remarked.

“Maybe Tranquility and Transcendent Emperor as well.” An ancestor said.

Earlier, the apex-level Yangrune Emperor looked imperious and grasped the battlefield with his palm.

However, the spear technique overshadowed him, revealing a disparity in power.
